admin_storage_backend_local_desc: Paste content is stored under DATA_DIR with JSON sidecar metadata.
admin_storage_backend_mysql_desc: Paste content is stored in the configured database as zstd-compressed chunks.
admin_uploads_disabled_desc: Existing paste links can still be viewed and deleted.
admin_uploads_enabled_desc: Users can create new paste links.
admin_delete_desc: This will delete all or selected pastes you created. Deleted data cannot be restored.
admin_delete_all_confirm: Delete all pastes? This cannot be restored.
admin_delete_selected_confirm: Delete selected pastes? Deleted data cannot be restored.
admin_setup_description: The first account becomes the only administrator account.
admin_login_description: Sign in with the administrator account to manage stored pastes.
admin_reset_description: Reset the administrator password with the configured reset token.
password_required_desc: Enter the password to view this paste.
not_found_desc: The paste may not exist, may have expired, or may have already been deleted.
clone_desc: A new paste link has been created from the current content.
manage_desc: Use this private link to change visibility, adjust the retention policy, or delete the paste without entering a password.
manage_generated_password_desc: Copy it now. It is shown only once.
manage_password_private_desc: Enter the current password to make this paste public again.
manage_password_public_desc: Generate a password and require it for future views.
manage_policy_desc: Switch between temporary, permanent, and one-time storage.
manage_delete_desc: Delete this paste immediately. This action cannot be undone.
manage_delete_confirm: Delete this paste? This cannot be restored.
manage_error_already_protected: This paste is already password protected
manage_error_generic: The requested change could not be applied
index_description: When you upload a file or text using curl, a 5-digit random URL is generated. The link will be automatically deleted after 30 days.
index_text_only_notice: Only text-based files are allowed. Images, media files, archives, and binary files are blocked.
index_data_policy_desc: Use 'data-policy: permanent' to keep a paste permanently, 'data-policy: once' to delete it after the first successful view, or durations like '12h' and '7d' for custom expiration up to 30 days.
index_expiration_desc: Temporary and custom-duration uploads include an expiration date in the upload response. Permanent uploads do not include an expiration date, and one-time uploads are deleted after the first successful view.
index_manual_deletion_desc: Each upload returns a delete URL. Open the URL or request it with curl to remove the uploaded content manually.
